To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of e learning in music education is a promising approach to improve students' independent and creative learning in a blended learning process.

the use of new technology in music education is a promising approach to support student teachers' learning music and that the use of e learning and social media in a blended learning method can be a good solution in music education.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new blended model of e learning for music education.
the development of a new blended model in teacher training for music studies and the use of e learning environments for music education in Finland.
the development of a new technology based model for student teachers learning music.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a new blended learning model in teacher education can help students to learn music in a more constructive way and to develop their own musical skills.
students' attitudes towards learning music in a blended learning model were positive.
a blended learning environment with new technology and a teacher's guidance in a music learning process can be an effective learning method to support student teachers' learning in music.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the students' experiences were positive and the use of new technology and e learning improved their attitudes towards independent and constructive learning in music.
the use of new technology in music studies in a blended learning method can help students to develop their musical skills and to improve their attitudes towards independent learning.
the students were able to learn music in a new blended learning model and the teacher could support students' independent and creative learning in music.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the blended learning method can be an effective tool to improve students' learning experience.
the blended learning environment was a good way of learning music.
the use of information and communications technologies improved students attitudes towards independent learning in their musical skills.
